London-headquartered football agency founded in 1997 by Leon Angel, now part of CAA Sports.

items.text: Represents more than 300 international players, coaches and managers, with consultant offices across Europe, South America, Australasia and North America.

items.text: Players and families travel privately in breaks and holidays; Egypt needs a discreet, reliable on-ground partner.
Client care at CAA Base sits with its football consultants: a CAA job listing describes the role as at the heart of client care, supporting players on and off the pitch.
items.source: CAA 'Football Consultant' listing (jobsinfootball.com; entertainmentcareers.net), seen 17 Oct 2026

items.text: No named player-care or client-services lead found in public sources; senior figures on record are Leon Angel and player agent Frank Trimboli (at the 2019 acquisition).
